body:
Decision Engine Service API Raw spec: /openapi.yaml
Local MySQL core profile: scenario authoring, publication, async/scheduled execution and history. External workflows, screening, scoring, callbacks and event delivery are unavailable. The shared reference includes additional routes; check /capabilities for this runtime.
Decision Engine Service API Raw spec: /openapi.yaml Swagger UI: /docs

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Decision Engine Service API
  version: 0.2.0
  description: |-
    This service helps teams define fraud scenarios, test decision logic, and review the decisions produced for tenant records.

    It also supports related workflow, screening, scoring, and execution tracking features used around the decision process.
tags:
  - name: Scenario Authoring
    description: Create and maintain tenant-owned scenarios, their draft and live iterations, publication state, and the rules that define decision logic over a target object type.
  - name: Validation
    description: AST and iteration validation against tenant data models.
  - name: Decisions
    description: Live evaluation, decision history, and ingestion-triggered execution.
  - name: Test Runs
    description: Test-run creation, listing, and evaluation.
  - name: Workflows
    description: Workflow definitions and execution records.
  - name: Execution
    description: Rule snoozes plus scheduled and asynchronous decision execution records.
  - name: Screening and Scoring
    description: Screening and scoring configuration and execution records.
  - name: Platform Helpers
    description: Helper-data endpoints consumed by evaluator functions.
  - name: Outbox
    description: Tenant-scoped outbox event inspection.
  - name: Health
    description: Basic service checks and setup details, including whether the service is running and ready to use.
  - name: Internal
    description: Internal service-to-service callbacks used by other backend services.
paths:
  /v1/investigator/tenants/{tenantId}/cases/{caseId}/review:
    parameters:
      - {name: tenantId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}
      - {name: caseId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}
    get:
      summary: Read current linked-resource investigator review eligibility
      description: Requires the original signed human JWT and current tenant, case, inbox and exact resource access. Service credentials cannot authorize this route.
      security: [{investigatorJWT: []}]
      parameters:
        - {name: resource_id, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authoritative review state; closed cases and inactive inboxes are not eligible.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/InvestigatorReviewState'}
        '400': {description: Invalid identifiers}
        '401': {description: Invalid investigator session}
        '403': {description: Current case or resource access denied}
        '500': {description: Owner state could not be read}
    post:
      summary: Record the first human review with atomic case history
      description: Open linked case and active inbox required. Findings are trimmed and limited to 10000 UTF-8 bytes. Original actor is verified from JWT; extra fields are rejected. Retry uncertain responses with the identical operation ID and payload. Human review does not change case lifecycle or machine outcome.
      security: [{investigatorJWT: []}]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [operation_id, resource_id, expected_version, action, findings]
              properties:
                operation_id: {type: string, format: uuid}
                resource_id: {type: string}
                expected_version: {type: string}
                action: {type: string, enum: [approve, decline]}
                findings: {type: string, minLength: 1}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Committed result or authorized identical-operation replay.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/InvestigatorReviewState'}
        '400': {description: Invalid command or case lifecycle}
        '401': {description: Invalid investigator session}
        '403': {description: Current case or resource access denied}
        '409': {description: Stale state or conflicting operation}
        '500': {description: Database failure or uncertain acknowledgement. Retry the same operation to determine the committed result.}
  /healthz:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Liveness probe
      description: Quick check that the service is up and responding.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is running
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusResponse'
  /readyz:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Readiness probe
      description: Checks whether the service is ready to handle requests.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is ready
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusResponse'
        '503':
          description: Service is not ready yet
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReadyErrorResponse'
  /v1/service-info:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Service metadata and upstream URLs
      description: Shows basic service details and the other services it is connected to.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceInfo'
  /v1/rule-functions:
    get:
      tags: [Validation]
      summary: List supported rule functions for AST authoring
      description: Returns the AST function catalog used by scenario and rule authoring clients.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Rule function catalog
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleFunctionListEnvelope'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List scenarios for one tenant
      description: Lists the scenario definitions owned by one tenant.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Create a scenario
      description: Creates a new scenario shell for one tenant. The scenario is later versioned through iterations.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateScenarioRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Get one scenario
      description: Returns one scenario definition by id.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    put:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Update one scenario
      description: Updates mutable scenario metadata such as name, description, and trigger object type.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateScenarioRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
    delete:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Delete one scenario
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Scenario deleted
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/copy:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Copy one scenario
      description: Creates a new scenario by copying the selected scenario and its authoring state.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CopyScenarioRequest'
            example:
              name: High Amount Review Copy
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario copy created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/rules/latest:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List rules from the latest iteration
      description: Returns the rules from the most recent iteration for the scenario.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Latest rule list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/ast-ai-description:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Describe a scenario expression with AI
      description: Reserved for future AI-assisted scenario explanations. This endpoint is currently not implemented.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '501':
          description: Not implemented
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotImplementedResponse'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/generate-ast:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Generate a scenario expression with AI
      description: Reserved for future AI-assisted rule generation. This endpoint is currently not implemented.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '501':
          description: Not implemented
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotImplementedResponse'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/editor-identifiers:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List payload and database accessor AST nodes for one scenario builder
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Builder accessor nodes
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EditorIdentifiersEnvelope'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List iterations for one scenario
      description: Lists the draft and live iterations belonging to one scenario.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Create a draft iteration
      description: Creates a new draft iteration for a scenario so rules and trigger logic can be edited safely.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Iteration created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/metadata:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List iteration metadata for one scenario
      description: Returns a lighter-weight iteration list for timeline or picker views.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration metadata list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationMetadataListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Get one iteration
      description: Returns one scenario iteration by id.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationEnvelope'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    put:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Update one draft iteration
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateIterationRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/draft:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Create a draft from an iteration
      description: Creates a new draft iteration by copying the selected iteration.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Draft iteration created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/commit:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Commit one iteration for publication
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration committed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/IterationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/deactivate:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Deactivate one live iteration
      description: Unpublishes the specified live iteration so the scenario no longer has an active live iteration.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Iteration deactivated and unpublish action recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationListEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/publications:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List publications for one scenario
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Publication list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Publish or unpublish an iteration
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationActionRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Publication actions recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationListEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/publications/preparation:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Get publication preparation status for one iteration
      description: Returns whether the target iteration still requires data-model preparation work before publication can complete.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - name: iteration_id
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Iteration identifier to check for publication preparation status.
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Publication preparation status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationPreparationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Start publication preparation for one iteration
      description: Starts any required data-model preparation work for the iteration and returns the updated preparation status.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                iteration_id:
                  type: string
                  description: Iteration identifier to prepare for publication.
              required: [iteration_id]
            example:
              iteration_id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Publication preparation started
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PublicationPreparationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/rules:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List rules for one iteration
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Rule list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Create a rule
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateRuleRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Rule created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/rule-groups:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List distinct rule groups used by one scenario
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Rule group list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleGroupListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/rules/{ruleId}:
    put:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Update one rule
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/RuleId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateRuleRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Rule updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RuleEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
    delete:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Delete one rule
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/RuleId'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Rule deleted
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/rules/{ruleId}/ai-description:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Describe a rule with AI
      description: Reserved for future AI-assisted rule explanations. This endpoint is currently not implemented.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/RuleId'
      responses:
        '501':
          description: Not implemented
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotImplementedResponse'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/iterations/{iterationId}/validate:
    post:
      tags: [Validation]
      summary: Validate one iteration and its rules against the tenant model
      description: Validates the trigger formula and rule formulas for one iteration against the current tenant data model.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IterationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Validation succeeded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationEnvelope'
        '422':
          description: Validation completed with rule or trigger errors
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationEnvelope'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/evaluate:
    post:
      tags: [Decisions]
      summary: Evaluate one scenario against one record payload
      description: Evaluates one scenario iteration set against one record payload and returns the resulting decision and rule executions when triggered.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EvaluateDecisionRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Evaluation result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DecisionEvaluationEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/PayloadValidation'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/decisions:
    get:
      tags: [Decisions]
      summary: List decisions by scenario
      description: Lists persisted decisions previously produced by one scenario. Use `limit` plus either `cursor` or `offset` for paged browsing when the scenario has many decisions. Cursor pagination is preferred for deep paging.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of decisions to return for the current page. Use this as the records-per-page control in paged UIs. When omitted, the full list is returned for backward compatibility.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 500
        - name: offset
          in: query
          description: Number of matching decisions to skip before collecting results. Do not combine with `cursor`.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `pagination.next_cursor` from a prior response. Do not combine with `offset`.
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: include_total_count
          in: query
          description: When `true`, compute and return `pagination.total_count` and `pagination.total_pages`. This is omitted by default for performance.
          schema:
            type: boolean
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Decision list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DecisionListEnvelope'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/decisions:
    get:
      tags: [Decisions]
      summary: List decisions by tenant with optional filters
      description: Lists persisted decisions for the tenant. Use query filters to narrow by scenario or by the evaluated object, and use `limit` plus either `cursor` or `offset` for paged browsing. components:
  securitySchemes:
    screeningCallbackAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: Dedicated SCREENING_CALLBACK_TOKEN; distinct from general, operator and opposite-direction credentials.
    investigatorJWT:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: RS256 human session with trusted issuer/audience, tenant_id and case_investigator or case_manager_admin role.
  parameters:
    TenantId:
      name: tenantId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Tenant identifier for the tenant that owns the scenario, decision, workflow, or execution record.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    ScenarioId:
      name: scenarioId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Scenario identifier for one decisioning scenario definition.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    IterationId:
      name: iterationId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Scenario iteration identifier for one draft or live version of a scenario.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    RuleId:
      name: ruleId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Rule identifier for one rule belonging to a scenario iteration or workflow rule set.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    DecisionId:
      name: decisionId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Decision identifier for one persisted scenario evaluation result.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    TestRunId:
      name: testRunId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Test-run identifier for one live-vs-phantom scenario evaluation run.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  responses:
    PayloadValidation:
      description: Supplied object violates the execution-time model; deterministic field issues contain no raw values.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    BadRequest:
      description: Request validation or domain validation failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    NotFound:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    InternalError:
      description: Internal processing failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    UpstreamError:
      description: Upstream dependency call failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
  schemas:
    InvestigatorReviewState:
      type: object
      required: [status, version, eligible, actions]
      properties:
        status: {type: string}
        version: {type: string}
        eligible: {type: boolean}
        actions: {type: array, items: {type: string}}
        machine_outcome: {type: string, description: Original machine result for decisions only}
    StatusResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required: [status]
    ReadyErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
        error:
          type: string
      required: [status, error]
    ServiceInfo:
      type: object
      description: Runtime service metadata and configured upstream base URLs.
      properties:
        service:
          type: string
          description: Static service identifier.
        data_model_service_url:
          type: string
          description: Base URL for the configured `data-model-service` dependency.
        ingestion_service_url:
          type: string
          description: Base URL for the configured `ingestion-service` dependency.
      required: [service, data_model_service_url, ingestion_service_url]
    ErrorEnvelope:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: object
              properties:
                code: {type: string}
                message: {type: string}
                category: {type: string}
                request_id: {type: string}
                details: {type: string}
        details:
          type: string
        model_revision:
          type: string
        truncated:
          type: boolean
        validation_errors:
          type: array
          maxItems: 100
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field: {type: string}
              code: {type: string}
              message: {type: string}
            required: [field, code, message]
      required: [error]
    JSONValue:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: true
    ASTNode:
      oneOf:
        - type: object
          properties:
            function:
              type: string
            constant: {}
            children:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
            named_children:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
          additionalProperties: true
        - type: array
          items: {}
        - type: string
        - type: number
        - type: boolean
    ASTNodeDTO:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        constant: {}
        children:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNodeDTO'
        named_children:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNodeDTO'
      additionalProperties: false
    CreateScenarioRequest:
      type: object
      description: Payload for creating or updating a scenario definition.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable scenario name.
        description:
          type: string
          description: Free-form explanation of what the scenario is intended to detect or decide.
        trigger_object_type:
          type: string
          description: Object type this scenario evaluates. In practice this matches the tenant data-model table name for incoming records, such as `transactions` or `customers`.
      required: [name, trigger_object_type]
      example:
        name: High Amount Review
        description: Review high-value transactions from new counterparties.
        trigger_object_type: transactions
    CopyScenarioRequest:
      type: object
      description: Optional values to use when creating a copied scenario.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Name to give the copied scenario.
      example:
        name: High Amount Review Copy
    ScenarioResponse:
      type: object
      description: Scenario definition owned by one tenant.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Stable scenario identifier.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the scenario.
        name:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable scenario name.
        description:
          type: string
          description: Free-form explanation of the scenario.
        trigger_object_type:
          type: string
          description: Object type the scenario evaluates. This matches the tenant model table name for the target records.
        live_iteration_id:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: Currently active live iteration for the scenario, when one exists.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
      required: [id, tenant_id, name, description, trigger_object_type, created_at, updated_at]
      example:
        id: scen_01HZY8M4TQ8XJ5G7S2B4N9K3PA
        tenant_id: tenant_demo
        name: High Amount Review
        description: Review high-value transactions from new counterparties.
        trigger_object_type: transactions
        live_iteration_id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
        created_at: '2026-07-14T09:00:00Z'
        updated_at: '2026-07-14T09:15:00Z'
    IterationResponse:
      type: object
      description: One versioned scenario iteration, usually draft or live.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Stable iteration identifier.
        scenario_id:
          type: string
          description: Parent scenario for this iteration.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the iteration.
        version:
          type: integer
          description: Version number assigned to the iteration within the scenario.
        status:
          type: string
          description: Iteration lifecycle state, such as draft or live.
        trigger_formula:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
        score_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a review outcome when configured.
        score_block_and_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a block-and-review outcome when configured.
        score_decline_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a decline outcome when configured.
        schedule:
          type: string
          description: Stored schedule expression or serialized schedule config for recurring execution when used.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        committed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
      required: [id, scenario_id, tenant_id, version, status, created_at]
      example:
        id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
        scenario_id: scen_01HZY8M4TQ8XJ5G7S2B4N9K3PA
        tenant_id: tenant_demo
        version: 3
        status: live
        trigger_formula:
          kind: literal
          value: true
        score_review_threshold: 50
        score_block_and_review_threshold: 80
        score_decline_threshold: 95
        schedule: ""
        created_at: '2026-07-14T09:01:00Z'
        committed_at: '2026-07-14T09:10:00Z'
    UpdateIterationRequest:
      type: object
      description: Mutable scenario-iteration fields. Omitted properties remain unchanged.
      properties:
        trigger_formula:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
        score_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
        score_block_and_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
        score_decline_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
        schedule:
          type: string
    MetadataIterationResponse:
      type: object
      description: Lightweight iteration record used for lists and timeline views.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Stable iteration identifier.
        scenario_id:
          type: string
          description: Scenario that owns the iteration.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the iteration.
        version:
          type: integer
          description: Iteration version number within the scenario.
        status:
          type: string
          description: Iteration lifecycle state, such as draft or live.

          type: string
          format: date-time
        committed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    PublicationActionRequest:

          type: string
      required: [action, iteration_id]
    PublicationResponse:

      description: Recorded publication or unpublication action for a scenario iteration.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Publication action identifier.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the publication record.
        scenario_id:
          type: string
          description: Scenario affected by the publication action.
        iteration_id:
          type: string
          description: Iteration that was published or unpublished.
        action:
          type: string
          description: Publication action performed, typically publish or unpublish.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
      required: [id, tenant_id, scenario_id, iteration_id, action, created_at]
    PublicationPreparationStatusResponse:
      type: object
      description: Preparation state for publishing one scenario iteration when data-model work is required first.
      properties:
        scenario_id:
          type: string
          description: Scenario whose iteration is being prepared for publication.
        iteration_id:
          type: string
          description: Iteration being checked or prepared for publication.
        preparation_required:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether publication currently depends on prerequisite preparation work.
        preparation_started:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether the required preparation work has already been started.
        preparation_finished:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether the required preparation work has finished.
        pending_items:
          type: integer
          description: Number of remaining preparation items or related jobs still blocking publication.
      required: [scenario_id, iteration_id, preparation_required, preparation_started, preparation_finished, pending_items]
      example:
        scenario_id: scen_01HZY8M4TQ8XJ5G7S2B4N9K3PA
        iteration_id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
        preparation_required: true
        preparation_started: true
        preparation_finished: false
        pending_items: 2
    CreateRuleRequest:
      type: object

Decision Engine Service API Raw spec: /openapi.yaml Swagger UI: /docs

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Decision Engine Service API
  version: 0.2.0
  description: |-
    This service helps teams define fraud scenarios, test decision logic, and review the decisions produced for tenant records.

    It also supports related workflow, screening, scoring, and execution tracking features used around the decision process.
tags:
  - name: Scenario Authoring
    description: Create and maintain tenant-owned scenarios, their draft and live iterations, publication state, and the rules that define decision logic over a target object type.
  - name: Validation
    description: AST and iteration validation against tenant data models.
  - name: Decisions
    description: Live evaluation, decision history, and ingestion-triggered execution.
  - name: Test Runs
    description: Test-run creation, listing, and evaluation.
  - name: Workflows
    description: Workflow definitions and execution records.
  - name: Execution
    description: Rule snoozes plus scheduled and asynchronous decision execution records.
  - name: Screening and Scoring
    description: Screening and scoring configuration and execution records.
  - name: Platform Helpers
    description: Helper-data endpoints consumed by evaluator functions.
  - name: Outbox
    description: Tenant-scoped outbox event inspection.
  - name: Health
    description: Basic service checks and setup details, including whether the service is running and ready to use.
  - name: Internal
    description: Internal service-to-service callbacks used by other backend services.
paths:
  /v1/investigator/tenants/{tenantId}/cases/{caseId}/review:
    parameters:
      - {name: tenantId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}
      - {name: caseId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}
    get:
      summary: Read current linked-resource investigator review eligibility
      description: Requires the original signed human JWT and current tenant, case, inbox and exact resource access. Service credentials cannot authorize this route.
      security: [{investigatorJWT: []}]
      parameters:
        - {name: resource_id, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authoritative review state; closed cases and inactive inboxes are not eligible.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/InvestigatorReviewState'}
        '400': {description: Invalid identifiers}
        '401': {description: Invalid investigator session}
        '403': {description: Current case or resource access denied}
        '500': {description: Owner state could not be read}
    post:
      summary: Record the first human review with atomic case history
      description: Open linked case and active inbox required. Findings are trimmed and limited to 10000 UTF-8 bytes. Original actor is verified from JWT; extra fields are rejected. Retry uncertain responses with the identical operation ID and payload. Human review does not change case lifecycle or machine outcome.
      security: [{investigatorJWT: []}]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [operation_id, resource_id, expected_version, action, findings]
              properties:
                operation_id: {type: string, format: uuid}
                resource_id: {type: string}
                expected_version: {type: string}
                action: {type: string, enum: [approve, decline]}
                findings: {type: string, minLength: 1}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Committed result or authorized identical-operation replay.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/InvestigatorReviewState'}
        '400': {description: Invalid command or case lifecycle}
        '401': {description: Invalid investigator session}
        '403': {description: Current case or resource access denied}
        '409': {description: Stale state or conflicting operation}
        '500': {description: Database failure or uncertain acknowledgement. Retry the same operation to determine the committed result.}

    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Liveness probe

  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: List scenarios for one tenant
      description: Lists the scenario definitions owned by one tenant.

        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Create a scenario
      description: Creates a new scenario shell for one tenant. The scenario is later versioned through iterations.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateScenarioRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}:
    get:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Get one scenario
      description: Returns one scenario definition by id.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    put:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Update one scenario
      description: Updates mutable scenario metadata such as name, description, and trigger object type.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateScenarioRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScenarioEnvelope'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UpstreamError'
    delete:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Delete one scenario
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TenantId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ScenarioId'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Scenario deleted
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/copy:
    post:
      tags: [Scenario Authoring]
      summary: Copy one scenario
      description: Creates a new scenario by copying the selected scenario and its authoring state.
      parameters:

        '201':
          description: Scenario copy created
          content:

        '400':

  /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}/rules/latest:

      description: Returns the rules from the most recent iteration for the scenario.

components:
  securitySchemes:
    screeningCallbackAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: Dedicated SCREENING_CALLBACK_TOKEN; distinct from general, operator and opposite-direction credentials.
    investigatorJWT:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: RS256 human session with trusted issuer/audience, tenant_id and case_investigator or case_manager_admin role.
  parameters:
    TenantId:
      name: tenantId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Tenant identifier for the tenant that owns the scenario, decision, workflow, or execution record.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    ScenarioId:
      name: scenarioId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Scenario identifier for one decisioning scenario definition.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    IterationId:
      name: iterationId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Scenario iteration identifier for one draft or live version of a scenario.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    RuleId:
      name: ruleId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Rule identifier for one rule belonging to a scenario iteration or workflow rule set.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    DecisionId:
      name: decisionId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Decision identifier for one persisted scenario evaluation result.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    TestRunId:
      name: testRunId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Test-run identifier for one live-vs-phantom scenario evaluation run.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  responses:
    PayloadValidation:
      description: Supplied object violates the execution-time model; deterministic field issues contain no raw values.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    BadRequest:
      description: Request validation or domain validation failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    NotFound:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    InternalError:
      description: Internal processing failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    UpstreamError:
      description: Upstream dependency call failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
  schemas:
    InvestigatorReviewState:
      type: object
      required: [status, version, eligible, actions]
      properties:
        status: {type: string}
        version: {type: string}
        eligible: {type: boolean}
        actions: {type: array, items: {type: string}}
        machine_outcome: {type: string, description: Original machine result for decisions only}
    StatusResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required: [status]
    ReadyErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
        error:
          type: string
      required: [status, error]
    ServiceInfo:
      type: object
      description: Runtime service metadata and configured upstream base URLs.
      properties:
        service:
          type: string
          description: Static service identifier.
        data_model_service_url:
          type: string
          description: Base URL for the configured `data-model-service` dependency.
        ingestion_service_url:
          type: string
          description: Base URL for the configured `ingestion-service` dependency.
      required: [service, data_model_service_url, ingestion_service_url]
    ErrorEnvelope:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: object
              properties:
                code: {type: string}
                message: {type: string}
                category: {type: string}
                request_id: {type: string}
                details: {type: string}
        details:
          type: string
        model_revision:
          type: string
        truncated:
          type: boolean
        validation_errors:
          type: array
          maxItems: 100
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field: {type: string}
              code: {type: string}
              message: {type: string}
            required: [field, code, message]
      required: [error]
    JSONValue:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: true
    ASTNode:
      oneOf:
        - type: object
          properties:
            function:
              type: string
            constant: {}
            children:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
            named_children:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
          additionalProperties: true
        - type: array
          items: {}
        - type: string
        - type: number
        - type: boolean
    ASTNodeDTO:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        constant: {}
        children:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNodeDTO'
        named_children:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNodeDTO'
      additionalProperties: false
    CreateScenarioRequest:
      type: object
      description: Payload for creating or updating a scenario definition.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable scenario name.
        description:
          type: string
          description: Free-form explanation of what the scenario is intended to detect or decide.
        trigger_object_type:
          type: string
          description: Object type this scenario evaluates. In practice this matches the tenant data-model table name for incoming records, such as `transactions` or `customers`.
      required: [name, trigger_object_type]
      example:
        name: High Amount Review
        description: Review high-value transactions from new counterparties.
        trigger_object_type: transactions
    CopyScenarioRequest:
      type: object
      description: Optional values to use when creating a copied scenario.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Name to give the copied scenario.
      example:
        name: High Amount Review Copy
    ScenarioResponse:
      type: object
      description: Scenario definition owned by one tenant.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Stable scenario identifier.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the scenario.
        name:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable scenario name.
        description:
          type: string
          description: Free-form explanation of the scenario.
        trigger_object_type:
          type: string
          description: Object type the scenario evaluates. This matches the tenant model table name for the target records.
        live_iteration_id:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: Currently active live iteration for the scenario, when one exists.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
      required: [id, tenant_id, name, description, trigger_object_type, created_at, updated_at]
      example:
        id: scen_01HZY8M4TQ8XJ5G7S2B4N9K3PA
        tenant_id: tenant_demo
        name: High Amount Review
        description: Review high-value transactions from new counterparties.
        trigger_object_type: transactions
        live_iteration_id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
        created_at: '2026-07-14T09:00:00Z'
        updated_at: '2026-07-14T09:15:00Z'
    IterationResponse:
      type: object
      description: One versioned scenario iteration, usually draft or live.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Stable iteration identifier.
        scenario_id:
          type: string
          description: Parent scenario for this iteration.
        tenant_id:
          type: string
          description: Tenant that owns the iteration.
        version:
          type: integer
          description: Version number assigned to the iteration within the scenario.
        status:
          type: string

        trigger_formula:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ASTNode'
        score_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a review outcome when configured.
        score_block_and_review_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a block-and-review outcome when configured.
        score_decline_threshold:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
          description: Minimum total score that yields a decline outcome when configured.
        schedule:
          type: string
          description: Stored schedule expression or serialized schedule config for recurring execution when used.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        committed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
      required: [id, scenario_id, tenant_id, version, status, created_at]
      example:
        id: iter_01HZY8NXVYH7V3A6TQ1M2C8W4F
        scenario_id: scen_01HZY8M4TQ8XJ5G7S2B4N9K3PA
        tenant_id: tenant_demo
        version: 3
        status: live
        trigger_formula:
          kind: literal
          value: true
        score_review_threshold: 50
        score_block_and_review_threshold: 80

        schedule: ""
        created_at: '2026-07-14T09:01:00Z'
        committed_at: '2026-07-14T09:10:00Z'
    UpdateIterationRequest:

        score_review_threshold:

          nullable: true

          nullable: true

          type: integer

        schedule:
          type: string
    MetadataIterationResponse:
      type: object
      description: Lightweight iteration record used for lists and timeline views.
      properties:

          type: string
